passages.text: At that time Abijah son of Jeroboam became ill, and Jeroboam said to his wife, “Now get up, disguise yourself so they will not recognize you as my wife, and go to Shiloh. For Ahijah the prophet is there; it was he who spoke about my kingship over this people.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was the king of Israel.
His son was Abijah.
At that time, Abijah became sick.
Jeroboam spoke to his wife.
He said, “Get up now.
Change your appearance.
Do not let them know you are Jeroboam’s wife.
Go to Shiloh.
Ahijah the prophet is there.
Ahijah spoke about me.
He said I would be king over these people.”
passages.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא חָלָ֖ה אֲבִיָּ֥ה בֶן־ יָרָבְעָֽם׃ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יָרָבְעָ֜ם לְאִשְׁתּ֗וֹ ק֤וּמִי נָא֙ וְהִשְׁתַּנִּ֔ית וְלֹ֣א יֵֽדְע֔וּ כִּי־ אַתִּי אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֑ם וְהָלַ֣כְתְּ שִׁלֹ֗ה הִנֵּה־ שָׁם֙ אֲחִיָּ֣ה הַנָּבִ֔יא הֽוּא־ דִבֶּ֥ר עָלַ֛י לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the boy.”
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was the king of Israel.
His son Abijah became ill.
Jeroboam spoke to his wife.
He told her to disguise herself.
He told her to go to Shiloh.
He told her to visit Ahijah the prophet.
Jeroboam said, “Take ten loaves of bread in your hand.
Take some cakes.
Take a jar of honey.
Go to Ahijah with these gifts.
Ahijah will tell you what will happen to the boy.”
passages.original: וְלָקַ֣חַתְּ בְּ֠יָדֵךְ עֲשָׂרָ֨ה לֶ֧חֶם וְנִקֻּדִ֛ים וּבַקְבֻּ֥ק דְּבַ֖שׁ וּבָ֣את אֵלָ֑יו ה֚וּא יַגִּ֣יד לָ֔ךְ מַה־ יִּֽהְיֶ֖ה לַנָּֽעַר׃

passages.text: Jeroboam’s wife did as instructed; she arose and went to Shiloh and arrived at Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were dim because of his age.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was the king of Israel.
His son Abijah became ill.
Jeroboam told his wife to disguise herself and go to Shiloh.
He told her to visit Ahijah the prophet.
Jeroboam’s wife obeyed.
She got up and went to Shiloh.
She arrived at the house of Ahijah.
Ahijah was an old prophet.
Ahijah could not see.
His eyes were weak because of his age.
passages.original: וַתַּ֤עַשׂ כֵּן֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֔ם וַתָּ֙קָם֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ שִׁלֹ֔ה וַתָּבֹ֖א בֵּ֣ית אֲחִיָּ֑ה וַאֲחִיָּ֙הוּ֙ לֹֽא־ יָכֹ֣ל לִרְא֔וֹת כִּ֛י קָ֥מוּ עֵינָ֖יו מִשֵּׂיבֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: But the LORD had said to Ahijah, “Behold, the wife of Jeroboam is coming to ask you about her son, for he is ill. You are to say such and such to her, because when she arrives, she will be disguised.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Ahijah.
The LORD said, “The wife of Jeroboam is coming to you.
She will ask you about her son.
Her son is ill.
You must say certain things to her.
When she arrives, she will be in disguise.”
passages.original: וַיהוָ֞ה אָמַ֣ר אֶל־ אֲחִיָּ֗הוּ הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֡ם בָּאָ֣ה לִדְרֹשׁ֩ דָּבָ֨ר מֵעִמְּךָ֤ אֶל־ בְּנָהּ֙ כִּֽי־ חֹלֶ֣ה ה֔וּא כָּזֹ֥ה וְכָזֶ֖ה תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֑יהָ וִיהִ֣י כְבֹאָ֔הּ וְהִ֖יא מִתְנַכֵּרָֽה׃

passages.text: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet entering the door, he said, “Come in, wife of Jeroboam! Why are you disguised? For I have been sent to you with bad news.
passages.sermon:
Ahijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Ahijah could not see because he was old.
Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she entered the door.
He knew it was the wife of Jeroboam.
He said, “Come in, wife of Jeroboam.”
He asked, “Why are you disguised?”
He said, “I have been sent to you with bad news.”
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אֲחִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־ ק֤וֹל רַגְלֶ֙יהָ֙ בָּאָ֣ה בַפֶּ֔תַח וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בֹּ֖אִי אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֑ם לָ֣מָּה זֶּ֗ה אַ֚תְּ מִתְנַכֵּרָ֔ה וְאָ֣נֹכִ֔י שָׁל֥וּחַ אֵלַ֖יִךְ קָשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: Go, tell Jeroboam that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I raised you up from among the people and appointed you ruler over My people Israel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks to Jeroboam.
The LORD says, "I raised you up from among the people."
I made you ruler over My people Israel.
I chose you and gave you authority.
You became leader because I appointed you.
passages.original: לְכִ֞י אִמְרִ֣י לְיָרָבְעָ֗ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֛עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲרִימֹתִ֖יךָ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָעָ֑ם וָאֶתֶּנְךָ֣ נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: I tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you. But you were not like My servant David, who kept My commandments and followed Me with all his heart, doing only what was right in My eyes.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeroboam through the prophet Ahijah.
God said, “I took the kingdom away from the house of David.
I gave the kingdom to you, Jeroboam.
You did not act like My servant David.
David kept My commandments.
David followed Me with all his heart.
David did only what was right in My eyes.”
passages.original: וָאֶקְרַ֤ע אֶת־ הַמַּמְלָכָה֙ מִבֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֔ד וָאֶתְּנֶ֖הָ לָ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־ הָיִ֜יתָ כְּעַבְדִּ֣י דָוִ֗ד אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁמַ֨ר מִצְוֺתַ֜י וַאֲשֶׁר־ הָלַ֤ךְ אַחֲרַי֙ בְּכָל־ לְבָב֔וֹ לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת רַ֖ק הַיָּשָׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָֽי׃

passages.text: You have done more evil than all who came before you. You have proceeded to make for yourself other gods and molten images to provoke Me, and you have flung Me behind your back.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was king of Israel.
Jeroboam did more evil than anyone before him.
Jeroboam made other gods for himself.
Jeroboam made images from metal.
Jeroboam did these things to make Me angry.
Jeroboam threw Me behind his back.
passages.original: וַתָּ֣רַע לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־ הָי֣וּ לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וַתֵּ֡לֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים אֲחֵרִ֤ים וּמַסֵּכוֹת֙ לְהַכְעִיסֵ֔נִי וְאֹתִ֥י הִשְׁלַ֖כְתָּ אַחֲרֵ֥י גַוֶּֽךָ׃ס

passages.text: Because of all this, behold, I am bringing disaster on the house of Jeroboam: I will cut off from Jeroboam every male, both slave and free, in Israel; I will burn up the house of Jeroboam as one burns up dung until it is gone!
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeroboam.
God said He would bring disaster on Jeroboam’s house.
God said He would cut off every male from Jeroboam’s family in Israel.
God said He would remove both slave and free from Jeroboam’s house.
God said He would destroy the house of Jeroboam completely.
God said He would burn up Jeroboam’s house like dung is burned until nothing is left.
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא רָעָה֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֔ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י לְיָֽרָבְעָם֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּקִ֔יר עָצ֥וּר וְעָז֖וּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבִֽעַרְתִּי֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בֵית־ יָרָבְעָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְבַעֵ֥ר הַגָּלָ֖ל עַד־ תֻּמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Anyone belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.’ For the LORD has spoken.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was the king of Israel.
God spoke a message about Jeroboam’s family.
Anyone from Jeroboam’s family who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs.
Anyone from Jeroboam’s family who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.
The LORD has spoken this word.
passages.original: הַמֵּ֨ת לְיָֽרָבְעָ֤ם בָּעִיר֙ יֹאכְל֣וּ הַכְּלָבִ֔ים וְהַמֵּת֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה יֹאכְל֖וּ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃

passages.text: As for you, get up and go home. When your feet enter the city, the child will die.
passages.sermon:
You are the wife of Jeroboam.
Jeroboam is the king of Israel.
God is speaking to you.
God commands you to get up.
God commands you to go home.
When your feet enter the city, the child will die.
passages.original: וְאַ֥תְּ ק֖וּמִי לְכִ֣י לְבֵיתֵ֑ךְ בְּבֹאָ֥ה רַגְלַ֛יִךְ הָעִ֖ירָה וּמֵ֥ת הַיָּֽלֶד׃

passages.text: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. For this is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will receive a proper burial, because only in him has the LORD, the God of Israel, found any good in the house of Jeroboam.
passages.sermon:
All Israel will mourn for this child.
All Israel will bury him.
This child belongs to Jeroboam.
He is the only one from Jeroboam’s house who will receive a proper burial.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD found something good only in this child from Jeroboam’s house.
passages.original: וְסָֽפְדוּ־ ל֤וֹ כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְקָבְר֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ כִּֽי־ זֶ֣ה לְבַדּ֔וֹ יָבֹ֥א לְיָרָבְעָ֖ם אֶל־ קָ֑בֶר יַ֣עַן נִמְצָא־ ב֞וֹ דָּבָ֣ר ט֗וֹב אֶל־ יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּבֵ֥ית יָרָבְעָֽם׃

passages.text: Moreover, the LORD will raise up for Himself a king over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day—yes, even today!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will choose a king for Himself over Israel.
This king will destroy the house of Jeroboam.
This will happen today.
It will happen even now.
passages.original: וְהֵקִים֩ יְהוָ֨ה ל֥וֹ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַכְרִ֛ית אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יָרָבְעָ֖ם זֶ֣ה הַיּ֑וֹם וּמֶ֖ה גַּם־ עָֽתָּה׃

passages.text: For the LORD will strike Israel as a reed is shaken in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land that He gave their fathers, and He will scatter them beyond the Euphrates, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking the LORD to anger.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will strike Israel.
He will strike them like a reed shaken in the water.
The LORD gave Israel a good land.
He gave this land to their fathers.
The LORD will uproot Israel from this good land.
He will scatter Israel beyond the Euphrates River.
Israel made Asherah poles.
These actions provoke the LORD to anger.
passages.original: וְהִכָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָנ֣וּד הַקָּנֶה֮ בַּמַּיִם֒ וְנָתַ֣שׁ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ֠עַל הָאֲדָמָ֨ה הַטּוֹבָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַן֙ לַאֲב֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וְזֵרָ֖ם מֵעֵ֣בֶר לַנָּהָ֑ר יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ אֲשֵׁ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם מַכְעִיסִ֖ים אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So He will give Israel over on account of the sins Jeroboam has committed and has caused Israel to commit.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will give Israel over to others.
The LORD will do this because of Jeroboam’s sins.
Jeroboam sinned against the LORD.
Jeroboam also led Israel to sin.
Because of these sins, the LORD will hand Israel over.
passages.original: וְיִתֵּ֖ן אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בִּגְלַ֞ל חַטֹּ֤אות יָֽרָבְעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then Jeroboam’s wife got up and departed for Tirzah, and as soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was the king of Israel.
Jeroboam had a wife.
Jeroboam’s wife stood up.
She left where she was.
She traveled to Tirzah.
She arrived at her house in Tirzah.
She stepped over the threshold of the house.
The boy died at that moment.
passages.original: וַתָּ֙קָם֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֔ם וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ וַתָּבֹ֣א תִרְצָ֑תָה הִ֛יא בָּאָ֥ה בְסַף־ הַבַּ֖יִת וְהַנַּ֥עַר מֵֽת׃

passages.text: And they buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word that the LORD had spoken through His servant Ahijah the prophet.
passages.sermon:
The people buried the boy.
All Israel mourned for the boy.
The LORD had spoken about this event.
The LORD spoke through His servant Ahijah.
Ahijah was a prophet.
passages.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ וַיִּסְפְּדוּ־ ל֖וֹ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּדְבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַד־ עַבְדּ֖וֹ אֲחִיָּ֥הוּ הַנָּבִֽיא׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he waged war and how he reigned, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was a king of Israel.
He fought wars.
He ruled as king.
Other things Jeroboam did are not listed here.
People wrote about these things in a book.
This book is called the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
You can find more about Jeroboam in that book.
passages.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י יָֽרָבְעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִלְחַ֖ם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מָלָ֑ךְ הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And the length of Jeroboam’s reign was twenty-two years, and he rested with his fathers, and his son Nadab reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was king of Israel.
He ruled for twenty-two years.
Jeroboam died.
He joined his ancestors in death.
Nadab was Jeroboam’s son.
Nadab became king after Jeroboam.
passages.original: וְהַיָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָלַ֣ךְ יָרָבְעָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁכַּב֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ נָדָ֥ב בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

passages.text: Meanwhile, Rehoboam son of Solomon reigned in Judah. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the LORD had chosen from all the tribes of Israel in which to put His Name. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was the son of Solomon.
Rehoboam became king in Judah.
Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king.
He reigned for seventeen years.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
The LORD had chosen Jerusalem from all the tribes of Israel.
The LORD chose Jerusalem to put His Name there.
Rehoboam’s mother was Naamah.
Naamah was an Ammonite.
passages.original: וּרְחַבְעָם֙ בֶּן־ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה בֶּן־ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וְאַחַ֣ת שָׁנָה֩ רְחַבְעָ֨ם בְּמָלְכ֜וֹ וּֽשֲׁבַ֨ע עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֣ה׀ מָלַ֣ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הָ֠עִיר אֲשֶׁר־ בָּחַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָשׂ֨וּם אֶת־ שְׁמ֥וֹ שָׁם֙ מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ נַעֲמָ֖ה הָעַמֹּנִֽית׃

passages.text: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and by the sins they committed they provoked Him to jealous anger more than all their fathers had done.
passages.sermon:
Judah was a tribe in Israel.
Judah did evil things.
The LORD saw what Judah did.
Judah sinned against the LORD.
Judah made the LORD very angry.
Judah’s sins were worse than the sins of their ancestors.
Judah provoked the LORD more than their fathers had done.
passages.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ יְהוּדָ֛ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְקַנְא֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ מִכֹּל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבֹתָ֔ם בְּחַטֹּאתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: They also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah built places for idol worship.
They made high places for themselves.
They set up sacred pillars.
They put up Asherah poles.
They did this on every high hill.
They did this under every green tree.
passages.original: וַיִּבְנ֨וּ גַם־ הֵ֧מָּה לָהֶ֛ם בָּמ֥וֹת וּמַצֵּב֖וֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִ֑ים עַ֚ל כָּל־ גִּבְעָ֣ה גְבֹהָ֔ה וְתַ֖חַת כָּל־ עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן׃

passages.text: There were even male shrine prostitutes in the land. They imitated all the abominations of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
Judah did evil in the land.
There were male shrine prostitutes in Judah.
The people of Judah copied the evil practices of other nations.
The LORD had driven out those nations before the Israelites.
Judah did the same abominations as those nations.
passages.original: וְגַם־ קָדֵ֖שׁ הָיָ֣ה בָאָ֑רֶץ עָשׂ֗וּ כְּכֹל֙ הַתּוֹעֲבֹ֣ת הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: In the fifth year of Rehoboam’s reign, Shishak king of Egypt came up and attacked Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king of Judah.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
In the fifth year of Rehoboam’s reign, something happened.
Shishak was king of Egypt.
Shishak came up against Jerusalem.
Shishak attacked Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֛י בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַחֲמִישִׁ֖ית לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֑ם עָלָ֛ה שׁוּשַׁק מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: He seized the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the royal palace. He took everything, including all the gold shields that Solomon had made.
passages.sermon:
Shishak was the king of Egypt.
Shishak attacked Jerusalem.
Shishak seized the treasures of the house of the LORD.
Shishak seized the treasures of the royal palace.
Shishak took everything.
Shishak took all the gold shields.
Solomon had made these gold shields.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־ אֹצְר֣וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶת־ אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְאֶת־ הַכֹּ֖ל לָקָ֑ח וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מָגִנֵּ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃

passages.text: Then King Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place and committed them to the care of the captains of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.
passages.sermon:
King Rehoboam ruled over Judah.
Shishak, king of Egypt, attacked Jerusalem.
Shishak took the gold shields that Solomon had made.
King Rehoboam made new shields.
He made these shields from bronze.
He gave the bronze shields to the captains of the guard.
These guards watched the entrance to the royal palace.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ רְחַבְעָם֙ תַּחְתָּ֔ם מָגִנֵּ֖י נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְהִפְקִ֗יד עַל־ יַד֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָרָצִ֔ים הַשֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים פֶּ֖תַח בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: And whenever the king entered the house of the LORD, the guards would bear the shields, and later they would return them to the guardroom.
passages.sermon:
King Rehoboam ruled Judah.
He made bronze shields to replace the gold shields that were taken.
Guards watched over these bronze shields.
Whenever King Rehoboam entered the house of the LORD, the guards carried the shields.
Afterward, the guards returned the shields to the guardroom.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֛י מִדֵּי־ בֹ֥א הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה יִשָּׂאוּם֙ הָֽרָצִ֔ים וֶהֱשִׁיב֖וּם אֶל־ תָּ֥א הָרָצִֽים׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, along with all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king of Judah.
He did many things during his reign.
The rest of the acts of Rehoboam are recorded.
All that he did is written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah.
passages.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י רְחַבְעָ֖ם וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣מָּה כְתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam throughout their days.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king of Judah.
Jeroboam was king of Israel.
Rehoboam and Jeroboam fought each other.
They were at war for their entire lives.
passages.original: וּמִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֧ה בֵין־ רְחַבְעָ֛ם וּבֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָ֖ם כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃

passages.text: And Rehoboam rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David; his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite. And his son Abijam reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king of Judah.
Rehoboam died.
People buried Rehoboam with his ancestors.
They buried him in the City of David.
Rehoboam’s mother was Naamah.
Naamah was an Ammonite.
Abijam was Rehoboam’s son.
Abijam became king after Rehoboam.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ב רְחַבְעָ֜ם עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֗יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֤ר עִם־ אֲבֹתָיו֙ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֔ד וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ נַעֲמָ֖ה הָעַמֹּנִ֑ית וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲבִיָּ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
